<div class="review-text">
One of the most engaging co-op shooters of all time set in a stunningly beautiful environment. The sense of humor is somewhat grating but the graphical direction is otherwise seamless. The solidly paced, flexible gameplay loop holds attention. The overall progression system feels like a chore, but is not necessary for enjoyable core gameplay.
